knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Recovery testing shows whether the whole chain, from surface to measurement, works.
The guide demands that test methods be proven before the cleaning study runs.
A null outcome can stem from weak recovery instead of a truly clean surface, so recovery is checked.

practicalCriteria: Learner reads a method validation record and states the concentration range and detection limit (pass: both stated correctly).
Learner identifies the missing check in a sample record and names it (pass: missing recovery or second check found).
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Identified missing check in the sample record
stopWorkCriteria: The test method has not been proven at the expected levels.
Solvent is used without its SDS controls or ventilation.
A data entry cannot be traced to its sample.
